title: Natural tensor identification with the canonical scalar-extension tower
statement: For the native internal coefficient modules of [det-pe-derived-nakayama-resolution] and the actual quotient maps and adjunctions of [sk-def-pe-derived-completion], the derived right tensor functor with the pulled-back quotient module at exponent n+1 is naturally isomorphic to derived extension along the quotient followed by exact restriction. The isomorphisms intertwine tensoring quotientStep with integralStep, and the right-unitor inverse followed by tensoring ε_Q and Q(single.map(finiteUnit)) with the actual derived scalar-extension adjunction unit. No scalar cone or cone-shift normalization is asserted.

theorem principal_tensor_scalar_extension :
    ∃ e : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedNakayama.reductionFunctor l E X (n + 1) ≅
        AdicCompletion.derivedReduction l E X n ⋙ AdicCompletion.restrict l E X n,
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (K : DerivedNakayama.Derived l E X),
        (DerivedNakayama.reductionMap l E X (AdicCompletion.quotientStep l E n)).app K ≫
            (e n).hom.app K =
          (e (n + 1)).hom.app K ≫ AdicCompletion.integralStep l E X K n) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (K : DerivedNakayama.Derived l E X),
        ((ρ_ K).inv ≫ K ◁
          (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε DerivedCategory.Q ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
            ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).map
              (AdicCompletion.finiteUnit l E X n)))) ≫ (e n).hom.app K =
          (Mod.derivedExtendMapDerivedCategoryAdjunction
            (AdicCompletion.quotient l E X n)).unit.app K)
